eval_cases.description: Multi-turn warranty triage checking item purchase and clarifying physical damage policy exclusions

parts.text: A customer is requesting a return for transaction TXN-20260312-0015811. What item was purchased?
Transaction TXN-20260312-0015811 was recorded on 2026-03-12 for a Toshiba TCx 810 POS Touch Display (SKU-TOS-810-D) covered under a 1-year Limited Manufacturer Warranty.
Does the warranty cover physical screen cracks caused by dropped equipment?

According to the certified hardware warranty policy for Toshiba TCx 810, physical impact damage, screen cracks, and accidental drops are explicitly excluded from standard warranty coverage. Recommend the store manager initiate an out-of-warranty repair quote.

eval_cases.description: Multi-turn intent switch from POS printer fix to inventory stockout check

parts.text: How do I fix ERR-PRN-2002 on Lane 3?

To clear ERR-PRN-2002 cutter lock: 1. Power off the printer. 2. Open the front cutter access door and manually rotate the knurled cutter gear until the blade retracts to home position. 3. Clear jammed paper fragments, close the cover firmly, power on, and execute a self-test print.
Now check if Store 8 has items with less than 20 hours stock cover.

Switching domain from POS hardware diagnostics to warehouse inventory analytics via cymbal_analytics_tool: Querying BigQuery inventory ledger for Store 8 to identify SKUs with estimated stock cover under 20.0 hours and report current on-hand quantities.
